message.content: A glossy pastel-blue render showing four white health crosses, but instead of four separate shield objects, they're baked into a single seamless tiled texture stretched over one blobby, roughly hexagonal mass — the shield outlines wrap around the whole silhouette like a wrapped gift, with dark crease lines and pinched, spiky folds at the corners and center seams. Colors are light blue, white, and lavender; materials read as soft glossy plastic/candy. Geometry problems: the tiling texture causes duplicated shields, warped proportions, corner spikes, and edge seams; the intended shield shape is lost entirely. Silhouette fidelity to a glossy shield-with-white-cross emblem: ~0.15 — crosses read clearly, but the shield silhouette is replaced by an arbitrary wrapped blob.
